coding.note: The report releases pretrained Mamba language models as well as presenting a method. Claims consolidate repeated abstract/introduction statements. Architecture and selection ablations use the common approximately 350M/Chinchilla setting (Tables 6–7). ONE is supported by the explicit single run for the longest-context DNA downstream result; learning-rate sweeps and repeated timing measurements are not independent training seeds. Comparator names are consolidated by family from Table 3. Comparator reevaluation and copied-score provenance are not explicit enough to code beyond NR: using EleutherAI's harness is not independent third-party evaluation. Data disclosure is conservatively PARTIAL because the Pile is named but its source mixture is not reproduced. Hardware used for speed benchmarks alone does not disclose training compute.
